SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 你那时候穿的是绿色的吧？

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Or was it mint… maybe light green?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 是薄荷绿来着…还是嫩绿色…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 是是薄荷綠嗎…還是淺綠色的
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ミントだったか…黄緑だったよな…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Mint ya... atau hijau muda gitu...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Era menta…? O verde clarito, algo así…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: شایدم سبز فسفری بود یا نعنایی...

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ちょっと、それ私じゃないんだけど？

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Wasn’t it? I could’ve sworn it was you.
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 違うって？いや、お前だったって
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Bukan? Tapi aku yakin itu kamu deh!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não era? Eu podia jurar que era você.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: نبودی؟! به جون خودم خودت بودی!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: That was Eun-bi and Seung-yi who wore those!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 那是恩妃和圣依穿的好不好！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: それ、ウンビとスンイが着てたやつでしょ！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Itu yang dipakai Eun-bi sama Seung-yi, tau!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Foram a Eun-bi e a Seung-yi que usaram isso!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اونا رو که ایون‌بی و سئونگ‌یی پوشیده بودن!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What am I even expecting from you…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我还能对你指望什么呢
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我對你還能有什麼期待呢
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はぁ…私がユマンに何を期待してるんだか
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku ngarep apa sih dari kamu...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: O que eu tô esperando de você mesmo…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: No sé qué espero de ti.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: منو بگو از کی چه توقعایی دارم...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I still feel like it was some kind of green though…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我记得好像是绿色的啊…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: でも、なんか緑っぽかった気がするんだよな…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Tapi rasanya warnanya agak-agak hijau gitu deh...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ainda acho que era algum tipo de verde…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Juraría que era un tono de verde…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ولی مطمئنم یه رگه‌هایی از سبز داشت لباسه ها...
